Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class LanDiscovery

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.LanDiscovery
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class LanDiscovery extends Object implements AutoCloseable
LAN auto-discovery over UDP multicast. While running, a node periodically multicasts a DiscoveryPacket announcing its fingerprint, nickname and TCP listen port, and listens for the same from other nodes on the subnet, surfacing them to a LanDiscovery.Listener as LanDiscovery.DiscoveredPeers. A peer that stops announcing expires after a TTL and is reported lost, so the UI's "Discovered peers (LAN)" list reflects who is actually reachable right now.

Honest scope. Discovery is LAN-scoped: the multicast TTL is 1 hop(s), so it does not route beyond the local subnet. Reaching a peer across the internet needs port-forwarding or a reachable host - the UI says so rather than pretending to traverse NAT. And a discovered peer is only a hint to connect: its identity is still verified cryptographically by the handshake and pinned by TOFU, never trusted from the (spoofable) announcement.

Threading and headless-safety. The constructor is inert - it opens no socket and starts no thread - so a headless-constructed owner spawns nothing. start() binds the multicast socket; if the environment forbids multicast it reports the problem to the listener and returns false rather than throwing, so discovery degrades gracefully to manual host:port. The receive loop and the announce/expiry scheduler are daemons. The peer-map and TTL logic (handlePacket(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.DiscoveryPacket, java.net.InetAddress), sweepExpired(long)) are pure and driven directly in tests without any socket.

  • Constructor Details

    • LanDiscovery

      public LanDiscovery(String fingerprint, String nickname, IntSupplier tcpPortSupplier, LanDiscovery.Listener listener)
      Creates an inert discovery instance using the default group, port and timings.
      Parameters:
      fingerprint - our identity fingerprint, stamped into announcements
      nickname - our display name
      tcpPortSupplier - supplies our current TCP listen port (may change if the node restarts); read at each announcement
      listener - the event sink (may be null)

    • LanDiscovery

      public LanDiscovery(String fingerprint, String nickname, IntSupplier tcpPortSupplier, LanDiscovery.Listener listener, String groupAddress, int udpPort, long ttlMs, long announceIntervalMs)
      Creates an inert discovery instance with full control over the group and timings (used by tests and any deployment that must avoid the defaults).
      Parameters:
      fingerprint - our identity fingerprint
      nickname - our display name
      tcpPortSupplier - supplies our current TCP listen port (may be null)
      listener - the event sink (may be null)
      groupAddress - the multicast group to join
      udpPort - the UDP port to bind and multicast to
      ttlMs - the peer expiry window in milliseconds
      announceIntervalMs - how often to re-announce, in milliseconds

    • start

      public boolean start()
      Binds the multicast socket, joins the group, and starts announcing and listening. Never throws: if multicast is unavailable the problem is reported to the listener and false is returned, leaving the instance inert.
